01.text: Hi, I'm Lélu. How can I help you today?

02.text: Lélu here. I found three new messages for you.

03.text: Of course. I'll remind you tomorrow morning at nine.

04.text: That's a good question. Let me think about it for a moment.

05.text: Your meeting with the design team starts in fifteen minutes.

06.text: I've saved the document and shared it with your project folder.

07.text: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?

08.text: Good night. Sleep well, and I'll be here when you wake up.
